title: Part 8
content_zh: Du Fu's poetry was the conscience of an empire in decline. While Li Bai soared above the clouds, Du Fu walked among the suffering people, recording every tear, every hunger, every injustice.
content_en: Du Fu's poetry was the conscience of an empire in decline. While Li Bai soared above the clouds, Du Fu walked among the suffering people, recording every tear, every hunger, every injustice.
